title: Availability updates immediately when rent record is created
gherkin:
Feature: Immediate Availability Synchronization
  Scenario: Availability updates immediately when rent record is created
    Given an item with initial availability for dates 2024-01-01 to 2024-01-10
    When a rent record is created for the item covering dates 2024-01-05 to 2024-01-07
    Then the item's availability should be immediately updated to exclude dates 2024-01-05 to 2024-01-07
    And subsequent availability queries should reflect the updated availability without delay
rationale: The operative context states 'The system shall update availability in real time when rent records are created' and 'The system shall ensure availability changes are applied immediately when relevant rental lifecycle events are updated.' This test verifies the core requirement that rent creation triggers immediate availability synchronization.
usedContextItems: The system shall update availability in real time when rent records are created, modified, cancelled, or completed.|The system shall ensure availability changes are applied immediately when relevant rental lifecycle events or availability controls are updated.
